findings.gap_and_impact: An air-quality warning with adequate airflow could lead to an unnecessary shaft-position check.
findings.minimum_change: Keep the general inspection until an actual low-flow follow-up of the current command arrives. Label the opening kitchen illustration on-screen.
findings.product_reason: A technician should only prioritize a damper when the commissioned airflow evidence warrants the check.
findings.verification: Real CSE on a PM-only initial event: six particle/CO₂/stopped-fan observations and two missing/stale cases produced no lookup. Subsequent low flow produced one. Check AI label and six narrated UI screens.
findings.decision_reason: This is the professional boundary between air quality and a diagnosed flow problem.
findings.recheck: Independent reviewer repeated the third-facility ACME run, rechecked 16 scoped tests and the original film frame. Valid low airflow triggers one request. Adequate airflow, particle-only, CO₂-only, fan-only, missing and stale input leave the general inspection in place.
